name: docker
description: *(DEPRECATED)* Enable Docker CLI access to Google Container Registry

options.name: --account
options.description: Google Cloud Platform user account to use for invocation.

options.name: --authorize-only
options.description: Configure Docker authorization only; do not launch the Docker command-line

options.name: --billing-project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project that will be charged quota for operations performed in gcloud.

options.name: --configuration
options.description: The configuration to use for this command invocation.

options.name: --docker-host
options.description: URL to connect to Docker Daemon.

options.name: --flags-file
options.description: A YAML or JSON file that specifies a *--flag*:*value* dictionary.

options.name: --flatten
options.description: Flatten _name_[] output resource slices in _KEY_ into separate records for each item in each slice.

options.name: --format
options.description: Set the format for printing command output resources.

options.name: --impersonate-service-account
options.description: For this gcloud invocation, all API requests will be made as the given service account instead of the currently selected account.

options.name: --log-http
options.description: Log all HTTP server requests and responses to stderr.

options.name: --project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project ID to use for this invocation.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Disable all interactive prompts when running gcloud commands.

options.name: --server
options.description: Address of the Google Cloud Registry

options.name: --trace-token
options.description: Token used to route traces of service requests for investigation of issues.

options.name: --user-output-enabled
options.description: Print user intended output to the console.

options.name: --verbosity
options.description: Override the default verbosity for this command.
